title: So, when you use SSH to connect, you don't get a menu?
body:
So, when you use SSH to connect, you don't get a menu?

_Originally posted by @Navid200 in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2723#discussioncomment-5236055_

comments.body: This is exactly what happened to me, no menu (connecting to serial ports disabled) I have already been using Xdrip+ and want to be able to show my Endocrinologist the data.  Setup is: Dexcom G6=>Xdrip+=>Aaps. If there is a better way for the Endo to see my progress, let me know and I will forego the Nightscout-google cloud endeavor.
